groupCodes.name: Contractual obligation
groupCodes.explanation: Provider write-off under the payer contract; the patient cannot be billed.

groupCodes.name: Patient responsibility
groupCodes.explanation: Amount the patient owes (deductible, coinsurance, copay or non-covered service the patient agreed to).

groupCodes.name: Other adjustment
groupCodes.explanation: Adjustment that is neither contractual nor patient responsibility, for example a prior payment or a reversal.
